faq.question: How long does a made-to-order dress take?
faq.answer: Around three weeks from the day the 25% advance is paid. You will be updated via WhatsApp.

faq.question: Do you offer ready-to-wear options?
faq.answer: Yes. Our Ready to wear rail is already stitched in standard sizes, made to the same standard quality, lower price and dispatched as soon as you place the order.

faq.question: What sizes are available?
faq.answer: Ranges from 0–3 years up to 13–16 years, and the price shown updates with the size you pick. Made-to-order pieces are cut to your child's body, waist and length measurements.

faq.question: Do you ship outside Lahore and Pakistan?
faq.answer: We ship nationwide across Pakistan and internationally as well. Delivery is charged separately from the prices shown. We will quote the courier charges according to your city or district.

about.heading: We started small, with a big dream
about.body:
Little Princess Designer is a family-run children's occasion-wear studio in Lahore, Pakistan. We started in 2015 on a small scale, with a big dream, and everything we have built since is the untold story of that hard work.

Every handmade girls dress, boys prince suit and baby set is cut in our own studio and hand-finished by the same small team — no outsourcing, no factory runs. Made-to-order pieces are fitted to your child's measurements; ready-to-wear pieces are stitched to the same standard and dispatched the same day.

We answer every WhatsApp message ourselves. Thank you for choosing Little Princess Designer.
